gloss: to cut down (a tree); to fell

definitions.gloss: to cut down (a tree); to fell
definitions.explanation: To cut through the base of a tree (or similar standing object) so that it falls over. Used both for forestry work and for removing individual trees in gardens or construction sites.

examples.english: I cut down the tree in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な{枯|か}れ{木|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{倒|たお}す⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to cut down the dangerous dead tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}{工事|こうじ}→道路工事：17070_dourokouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{何本|なんぼん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}り{倒|たお}された。
examples.english: Many trees were cut down for the road construction.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut) + ⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧ (to knock over). Transitive godan verb. Implies cutting all the way through so the tree topples, in contrast to mere pruning or trimming.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive — takes a direct object marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{倒|たお}す.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{倒|たお}す: to fell a tree
- ⟦{森林|しんりん}→森林：01441_shinrin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{倒|たお}す: to cut down a forest
- ⟦チェーンソー→チェーンソー：30211_cheensoo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{切|き}り{倒|たお}す: to fell with a chainsaw

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伐採|ばっさい}→伐採：08435_bassai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to log; to fell — more technical, used for forestry
- ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut — general; doesn't imply the tree falls
- ⟦{剪定|せんてい}→剪定：06327_sentei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prune — trimming branches, not cutting down the tree
